proposal.reason: Main change is in CE/DMA execution: it reserves/retargets CE vs ltOki rings and queue IDs, applies memcpy stream channel hints on enqueue/init, and adjusts CE batch stream-group usage to prevent mixed CE AllGather + ltOki AR/RS hangs. Also requires symmetric review because symmetric OKI CE device-kernel logic changes AR/RS tail sizing and lane split alignment, which is a separate correctness change in symmetric collective kernel code.
